notes.title: Version 1.0.9. Localizations and other updates.
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] In the tutorial mode, we fixed a wrong icon which appeared in the announcement about army unblocking;
[*] We corrected a lot of mistakes in English localization;
[*] We added our volunteers Richard Bepple, canemus and XzibitusaK to the list of Authors of the game;
[*] We fixed the mistake which made the game freeze in random situations.
[/list]

[h1]Balance fix:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We fixed a bug that allowed to boost Food and Production during the "Crime" event.
[/list]

[h1]Others:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We updated links to our social networks accounts;
[*] We redesigned the selector of languages in the game;
[*] Now it's impossible to start the game without entering the name of a player.
[/list]

notes.title: iOS (iPhone/iPad) version of Predynastic Egypt: testers WANTED!

If everything is okay we'll send you the email with invitation link via TestFlight app to beta-version of the game. To get access to the game you must be able to open email on your iOS device.

During the test you'll need to complete the game (win or loose - no matter) looking for any bugs, FPS problems, any issues you like. The test will continue from 10 Feb to 17 Feb and new version will be uploaded aproximately every 2 days. So please spend no more then 2 days per 1 version. 

Hurry up, the amount of testers is limited.
The game only available for the devices with x64bit CPU architecture listed below:[list]

Android version will be available later.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 + Achievements+ DE and FR localizations
notes.notes:
Dear players! We are pleased to inform you that the new update is completed. Fixed bugs, made a lot of changes and long-awaited Achievements are available. More details can be found below.

Attention! With the new update, there may be compatibility issues with older savegames from previous versions. In order to avoid them, we suggest to start a new game or continue an old version game with previous version.

To switch the versions, use the BETAS tab in game Properties in Steam library.
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26536817/241d209fed7ed2f672ccd8c1ddcac2c530c979d1.jpg[/img]
[h1]New features:[/h1][list]
[*]Added German and French languages
[*]Added 84 Steam Achievements with new goals and challenges!
[*]Added animation «death of the worker» and the camera moves to the dies worker at the time when this happens.
[*]Added option to adjust the frequency of autosaves in the game settings
[*]Added a new event "Game goals", it shows as a permanent trial and serves as a reminder about the global goals of the game
[/list]
[h1]Changes in the demo[/h1][list]
[*]Demo Version updated to 1.0.2 version and now available in German and French languages too.[/list]
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26536817/df7d5456b7ff20c6f95e52d6666da63f4cab5e45.jpg[/img]
[h1]Changes in the game:[/h1][list]
[*]Map camera returns to its original position after displacement
[*]Chances of rebellion and invasion, now cannot be higher than 100%
[*]Duration of Humidification of the Sahara event now lasts 4 turns, instead of 2
[*]Slightly increased the frequency of occurrence of random events after the end of the game.
[*]Improved irrigation. Now any field built after irrigation, still get +1 food.
[*]Tribes on the map of Egypt sometimes will have a “knowledge” as a tradable good.
[*]If the technology “Primitive army” has not been studied during the failure of the subjugation of another tribe, the losses of our tribe will be 2 times less, not 4 but 2 people.
The amount of resources received from the events National Inspiration during the last trial was increased. The farer you from the goal conditions, the more appropriate resource will be given to you as you getting the end of the game. For example, the longer you fail to explore the technology “Single Pantheon”, the more culture you will get from the National inspiration.
[*]Links in the game are now lead to the site of Pre-Civilization series, not only Egypt.
[*]AutoSave notification now appears now only once, during tutorial.
[*]If you start to honor God Seth before the great drought, the preamble of this test will change.
[*]Other small interface improvements
[*]More than 100 text fixes.[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed a bug due to which after loading the game, the new workers do not consume food.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which if, during the any trading, the Improvement of relations event has appeared, the effect of trade remained the same.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which if during the trade, the Strengthening of the tribe event has appeared, the icon-indicator of tribe strength has not changed.
[*]Fixed bug because of which the hint on the last trial was given after scoring, and now you can get it immediately.
[*]Fixed a bug with the "wandering cloud" that appeared even if all maps have been explored.
[*]Fixed a bug when player built barracks in one turn and in the same turn they were immediately damaged during the event, the game became incompletable.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which when counting the scores in the description Challenge of the Gods, the bonus was 0 instead of +2.
[*]Fixed a glitch when the Wedding event was not canceled even after the attack on the bride’s tribe.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which in case of early subjugation of Ombos, there still was a mission to unite with the Thinis.
[*]Fixed bug where under certain conditions, were the improperly disappearance of the tribes.[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 "Players' wishes" is uploaded
notes.notes:
We considered the players’ wishes and seriously improved the game. To fully appreciate the changes, please first start the game from the tutorial.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1][list]
[*]Added: the game does not end after 220 turn.
[*]Added: Auto-save, quick save (F5) and quick load (F9)
[*]The easy difficulty became much more easier and on the other difficulties became slightly easier. Various rebalance of the game - about 20 changes.
[*]Improved tutorial, usability and logic of the game, added many new functions and improved old ones. More than 30 changes and innovations.
[*]Fixed known errors such as error of loading saved games. Totally more than 15 different bugs.
[*]A major revision of the texts of the game: 210 changes in the English text, and about 80 in Russian.[/list]
